sources.title: Open a Joint Bank Account | Simplify Shared Costs with Monzo
Monzo Help - How to open a Monzo Joint Account

brands.evidence: Yes. You can apply for a Monzo joint current account if you’re both 18 or over

client_claims.text: You can apply for a Monzo joint current account if you’re both 18 or over, live in the UK full-time and each have your own Monzo personal current account.
client_claims.note: Eligibility criteria not covered by the facts.

client_claims.text: You don’t need to be married or even a couple – you can open one with a friend or flatmate.
In the Monzo app, go to Home → + → Open a joint account and invite the other person.
You each get a debit card for the joint account and can see its balance and transactions in your own app.
Either of you can spend or withdraw money without the other’s approval.
If the account goes overdrawn, Monzo can ask either of you to repay the full amount, not just half.
Opening the account links your credit files; scores stay separate but lenders may consider the other person’s credit history.
